test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 9 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: The new Centre for Water Management and Policy, Aqua MAP was inaugurated in March 2022 by the Principal Scientific Adviser to the Government of India, K Vijay Raghavan at which of the following IITs?
solution:
The correct answer is __**IIT- Madras**.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Aqua MAP** Center for Water Management and Policy at **IIT Madras** aims to create awareness and implement sustainable solutions to impact water management practices on a national scale.
 
• The problems related to water availability have wide reached implications for residents in arid areas specifically, in rural areas.
 
 
• Population growth
 
• Industrial development
 
• Encroachment of water bodies such as lakes and ponds
 
• Misguided policies
 
 
 
• **Aim-**
 
 
• **​**IITM Alumni and IITM Faculty aim to work together and set up.
 
• IITM Alumni wish to do their best to solve the pressing and impending water crises in our country.
 
 
 
• The Principal Scientific Adviser to the Government of India, inaugurated the new water management and policy Centre, Aqua MAP, at IIT Madras and **launched its website – https://aquamap.iitm.ac.in/ on March 19, 2022**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Prof. Ligy Philip**, announcing the **first three projects** the Centre is supporting, said, "We have a multi-disciplinary faculty team, from Chemistry, Civil, Chemical, and Humanities departments, supporting me at Aqua MAP.
 
• **Dr. Balasubramanian said**, "Krishnan and I are thankful to IIT Madras for giving us an opportunity to give back to **our alma mater** and to the nation through Aqua MAP.
 
• **Water and soil quality analysis:** Creation of a digital twin of the Village for environmental management. Waste management for Clean and Healthy Village Automatic Control of Rural Water Supply Schemes.
 
• "Water consumption in the agriculture sector is the **maximum among all the needs**, and therefore focus on improving the agricultural water use efficiency is **one of the major focuses of Aqua MAP**."
